selection: Explicit initial task.preset selected semantically by the coordinator; no task-text classifier or automatic retry ladder.
limits: These five owner-approved bounded scopes do not promote whole roles or replace source/runtime/device/release acceptance. Public qualification uses synthetic fixtures and exact consumer evidence.

native-write-fix.scope: An accepted, bounded existing native writer fix with explicit partial-write, error, counter and custody contracts and exact owned paths. Excludes new architecture, cross-owner changes and broad runtime qualification.
acceptance: Exercise the exported helper through its real consumer, including positive short writes, n>0 with error and no progress.
Preserve accepted-byte accounting, payload identity, writer ownership and nil/empty-input behavior.
Report actual checks and limits; the fixture does not authorize an unrelated product change or device/release claim.

evidence.limits: Verify the actual task consumer and frozen selection; no general model-superiority or broader role-default claim.

native-accounting-review.scope: Read-only review of bounded existing native writer differences against explicit counter, receipt, error and ownership contracts. Excludes arbitrary source review, cross-owner security/concurrency and runtime-wide acceptance.
acceptance: Tie each finding to a changed path, trigger, observed effect and required correction.
Identify supported clean candidates and preserve native batching and accepted-byte boundaries.
Distinguish source tests from executed checks and retain unresolved limits.

delivery-evidence-review.scope: Read-only adjudication of bounded tooling/native-source-host receipts through exact caller, result, source-root and generation evidence. Excludes whole-runtime behavior, device and release qualification.
acceptance: Classify each package from its actual call/result/root evidence, including conflicting or missing fields.
Separate configured identity from observed execution and historical or mutated traces from fresh runs.
Name the smallest concrete consumer check for unsupported claims; do not learn acceptance from polished prose.

tool-update-evidence.scope: Bounded dependency/runtime-tool update evidence with exact versions, source behavior and retained compatibility boundaries. Excludes upstream runtime merge approval, cross-owner changes and broad upgrade research.
acceptance: Keep version-specific behavior, compatibility retention and exact artifact identities distinct.
Report contradictions, chronology, unavailable license facts and the next actual consumer check.
Do not install, remove compatibility or widen platform claims without the task's separate authority and evidence.

existing-writer-solution.scope: Bounded selection among existing/native/direct writer APIs for decoded-byte receipts, identity, batching and partial-write behavior. Excludes arbitrary architecture, cross-owner mechanisms and new capability delivery.
acceptance: Map each supplied writer case to a supported operation or an honest unsupported outcome.
Preserve writer identity, prior buffered-byte boundaries and actual accepted-byte credit.
